channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Dr Soo Wincci skips CNY feasts for 15th year of fasting
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Multihyphenate star Dr Soo Wincci is ushering in the fasting month with a disciplined approach, choosing to scale back her Chinese New Year celebrations to ensure she is physically ready for Ramadan.

item.title: Cops act on viral post, raid illegal gambling den in JB
item.description: JOHOR BARU: A 56-year-old man was arrested yesterday for allegedly running an illegal gambling den from a shop lot in Dataran Larkin here.

item.title: Majuperak Q4 profit jumps 85pct on strong project contributions
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Majuperak Holdings Bhd reported a net profit of RM11.66 million for the fourth quarter ended Dec 31, 2025, marking an 85.5 per cent rise from RM6.3 million, driven by robust growth across its main business segments.

item.title: Financial troubles drive Pahang security guard to murder-suicide of family
item.description: KUANTAN: The 32-year-old security guard who killed his family in a murder-suicide a week ago was driven by financial troubles, police said.

item.title: Jailed Pakistan ex-PM Khan gets eye treatment: Hospital
item.description: ISLAMABAD: Pakistan’s jailed former prime minister Imran Khan received eye treatment on Tuesday, according to a hospital statement, although a spokesman for the ex-cricket star complained he was not allowed to see his personal doctor.

item.title: LPI Capital Q4 profit slips as insurance earnings weaken
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: LPI Capital Bhd’s net profit dropped in the fourth quarter ended Dec 31, 2025 (Q4 FY25), due to lower profit from the general insurance segment.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Bruce Willis' daughter works 4 jobs, doesn't get money from parents
item.description: NEW YORK: Bruce Willis and Demi Moore’s eldest daughter, Rumer Willis, says she works “four different jobs” to support her young daughter and doesn’t “get money” from her famous parents.

item.title: Kim Yo Jong: Powerful sister behind North Korea's supreme leader
item.description: KIM Yo Jong, the younger sister of Kim Jong Un, has emerged as one of the most powerful figures in North Korea, playing a leading role in the nation’s diplomatic efforts and nuclear posturing.

item.title: AG's Report debate highlights govt push for transparency, reforms
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Auditor-General’s Report debate in Dewan Rakyat reflects the government’s commitment to transparency, checks and balances, and integrity-based governance under the Madani framework, a senior minister said.

item.title: Aaron-Wooi Yik face Malaysian banana skins at All England
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: World No. 2 Aaron Chia-Soh Wooi Yik could find themselves having to navigate past compatriots multiple times in their bid to finally land a maiden All England title when the world’s oldest tournament takes centre stage from March 3-8 in Birmingham.
